public_rule.description: Public resources — month edge, browser revalidation
public_rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "PURGE"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and not has_key(http.request.headers, "authorization") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-markdown/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/mcp" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/mcp/"))

markdown_storage.mechanism: Workers Cache API public document copies
markdown_storage.key: document path and full SHA-256 query v; never negotiated HTML URL
markdown_storage.headers: rebuild current revision and language after every validated hit
markdown_storage.purge: global prefix purge of the document path, not unsupported single-URL custom-key purge
